mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or near zero compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls indicates a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises simultaneously

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market recovery (HOUST > 1200 thousand units), rising home construction stimulates consumer spending and business investment, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0%

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust aggregate demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises and HOUST rises simultaneously

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 240), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 240
